answer: Every ballot moors at the jetty and sends a signed pulse each tide, a heartbeat stamped with the tide beacon, and must pulse a 6-hour tide before it may vote. Five samplers FFT the gaps between arrivals: honest hands jitter 250 to 550 ms apart, with a stray 1,200 ms pause. A forge stamping 10,000 pulses from one script dies by the synchrony check: its pulses land inside one 50 ms window, correlation above 0.9, so the cluster is slashed — $25 bonds, $250,000 in all — and every ballot rejected. ND-Sync caught synchronized retweet fraud at 97% on 12 million retweets; one clock, one grave.
